solutionSql:
CREATE VIEW billed_shipments AS
SELECT i.shipment_id, s.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, i.amount
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN shipments AS s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id;

ambiguities.readingChosen: Inner joins invoices -> shipments -> customers; the NOT NULL foreign keys guarantee every invoice keeps exactly one row.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: LEFT JOINs from invoices to protect invoices whose shipment or customer is missing; identical results while the foreign keys hold.

notes: Joined invoices to shipments on shipment_id, then shipments to customers on customer_id; customer_name is customers.name aliased. Sample: 205 invoices, 205 view rows. information_schema reports integer, integer, text, numeric in the ticket's order. No tables changed.
